headline: Public hearings on a variance for a house on ES Laurelton St and an illuminated sign at 1027 East Columbus Ave.
summary: The meeting includes two public hearings on variance petitions. One covers a single-family house on a lot with less than 5000 sq ft at ES Laurelton St; the other covers an illuminated ground sign 45 ft high with 200 sq ft per side at 1027 East Columbus Ave.
items: Public hearing on variance petition for ES Laurelton St, Property ID 075600047, applicant A & T properties, Residence "A" zoning district: request to construct a single-family house on a lot with less than 5000 sq ft of land area, which would violate Springfield Zoning Ordinance Article 10 section 10.2.12 paragraph A.

Public hearing on variance petition for 1027 East Columbus Ave, Property ID 043030539, applicant Springfield Spirit LLC, Business "B" zoning district: request to erect an illuminated ground sign 45 ft in height with 200 sq ft per side, which would violate Springfield Zoning Ordinance Article 9 section 8 paragraphs 42, 43, and 44 and Table 9-2.

ZONING BOARD OF APPEALS 
REGULARLY SCHEDULED MEETING 
 
 
WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 28, 2026 
 
                                                                                                     Agenda 
                                                            
 
 
 
 
 
I. OPENING REMARKS & PROCEDURES (CHAIRPERSON) 
II. ACCEPTANCE OF MINUTES 
III. PUBLIC HEARING – VARIANCE PETITION 
a. Address:    ES Laurelton St  
b. Property ID #:   075600047  
c. Applicant:   A & T properties  
d. Zoning District:   Residence “A”  
e. Applicable Provisions & Request:   A variation from the requirements of the 
Springfield Zoning Ordinance. “So as to be allowed to construct a single-family 
house on a lot with less than 5000 sq ft of land area” that would be in violation 
of the Springfield Zoning Ordinance Article 10 section 10.2.12 paragraph A 
IV. PUBLIC HEARING – VARIANCE PETITION 
a. Address:     1027 East Columbus Ave  
b. Property ID #:   043030539  
c. Applicant:   Springfield Spirit LLC  
d. Zoning District:   Business “B”  
e. Applicable Provisions & Request:  A variation from the requirements of the 
Springfield Zoning Ordinance. “So as to be allowed to erect an illuminated 
ground sign that is 45 ft in height and has 200sq ft per side” that would be in 
violation of the Springfield Zoning Ordinance Article 9 section 8 paragraphs 
42,43,and 44 and  Table 9-2
